notes.title: Right trigger now shoots!
notes.notes:
In response to the review request I have enabled the right trigger to shoot.

Let me know what else you want?

notes.title: Public play-test
notes.notes:
We need your help to make SpaceyVade the best it can be!

[h1]What[/h1]
A limited level public play-test to gather feedback and start promoting the upcoming release.

[h1]Who[/h1]
Everyone is welcome, all I ask is that you tell me what you like and dislike.

[h1]When[/h1]
Starting next week and will run for 2 weeks so get in early.

Please post any feedback [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1584500/discussions/0/]to this board[/url]?
